stem: Trapezoid \(PQRS\) is rotated 180° about the origin to form trapezoid \(P'Q'R'S'\). Which statement is true?

options.label: F
options.text: The sum of the angle measures of trapezoid \(PQRS\) is 180° less than the sum of the angle measures of trapezoid \(P'Q'R'S'\).

options.label: G
options.text: Trapezoid \(PQRS\) is not congruent to trapezoid \(P'Q'R'S'\).

options.label: H
options.text: The area of trapezoid \(PQRS\) is less than the area of trapezoid \(P'Q'R'S'\).

options.label: J
options.text: The angle measures of trapezoid \(PQRS\) are equal to the corresponding angle measures of trapezoid \(P'Q'R'S'\).

visual_elements: coordinate grid with trapezoid PQRS placed with points P(-5,4), Q(3,4), R(4,-2), S(-7,-2)
